faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our services and pricing.

1.question: What is included in the initial consultation?
1.answer: Our initial consultation includes a thorough discussion of your project requirements, goals, timeline, and budget. We'll provide recommendations and a detailed proposal tailored to your needs.

2.question: How long does it take to complete a website?
2.answer: Project timelines vary depending on complexity. A basic website typically takes 2-4 weeks, while more complex projects with custom functionality may take 6-12 weeks or more.

3.question: Do you offer ongoing maintenance services?
3.answer: Yes, we offer various maintenance packages to keep your website secure, updated, and performing optimally. These can be added to any of our plans.

4.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
4.answer: Absolutely! You can upgrade your plan at any time as your business grows and needs evolve. We'll help you transition smoothly to a more comprehensive solution.

5.question: Do you provide hosting services?
5.answer: Yes, we offer reliable hosting solutions optimized for performance and security. However, if you prefer to use your own hosting provider, we can accommodate that as well.
